title: Scanner-definition candidate discriminator
failure_signature: The five-class privacy scanner classified its own private-path regular-expression literal as a confirmed hit.
trigger_preconditions: A scanner source file is included in the exact staged-file domain.
The source contains the literal patterns it is designed to detect.
candidate_workaround: Retain every raw candidate, inspect the matching source line, and classify only pattern-definition lines in the scanner itself as scanner-definition candidates rather than confirmed artifact leaks.
recurrence_guard: Report candidate and confirmed-hit counts separately; never discard scanner self-matches without exact line-context classification.
rollback: Restore fail-closed classification if a candidate is outside an exact scanner-definition line.
scope_boundary: Exact staged scanner-definition lines only; zero confirmed hits is not complete privacy assurance.
